$comment: Single source of truth for Pixy app facts. Store text, README, website, and directories derive from this file. Change facts here only. Verify against source and live stores before editing.

identity.name: Pixy
identity.tagline: Track your mood, one pixel at a time.
identity.shortDescription: Pixy is a free, open-source mood tracker for iPhone and Android. Log moods, add notes and tags, and explore your history in a pixel calendar.
identity.description: Pixy Mood Tracker helps you record your mood in a simple, colorful daily log. Add optional notes and tags, browse past days in a pixel calendar, filter entries, and view mood statistics. Mood entries are stored on your device. The app is free, and its source code is available under the MIT license.

claims.$comment: Booleans the public copy may state. Each must stay true for the store version and the source version.

optionalTip.note: Optional one-time tip in Settings exists in source since 1.87.0. Not in the store version. Set available to true after the store release.

store.note: Same version on App Store and Google Play. Update after each store release.

featureStatuses.available: Works in the source version. Public copy may claim it.
featureStatuses.legacy: Only shows data created by older versions. Do not claim.
featureStatuses.removed: Existed in an earlier version. Do not claim.
featureStatuses.unavailable: Never existed. Listed so comparisons can say no.

features.label: Mood rating
features.description: Rate a moment on a 7-step color scale, from extremely bad to extremely good.

features.label: Several entries per day
features.description: Log as many entries per day as you like. The calendar groups them by day.

features.label: Add and edit past entries
features.description: Create an entry for any day and edit existing entries.

features.label: Emotions with descriptions
features.description: Pick one or more of 72 emotions. Each emotion has a short description.
features.note: 161 emotions defined, 89 disabled. 30 in the basic view, 42 more expanded.

features.label: Custom tags
features.description: Create your own tags for activities, people, or places. Add them to entries, edit and archive them.

features.label: Notes
features.description: Write about your day in an optional note on each entry.

features.label: Choose your check-in steps
features.description: Turn each check-in step on or off: mood, tags, emotions, note, feedback.

features.label: Sleep quality
features.description: Sleep quality cannot be logged anymore. Entries and the sleep chart only show ratings saved by older versions.

features.label: Writing tips and prompts
features.description: Removed in 1.88.0.

features.label: Pixel calendar
features.description: Every day is one colored square in a month calendar. Scroll back to older months.

features.label: Year in pixels
features.description: A whole year of moods on one screen, one pixel per day, in the yearly report.

features.label: Search and filters
features.description: Filter the calendar by text, mood rating, and tags.

features.label: Statistics highlights
features.description: Mood average, mood chart, mood peaks, tag peaks, tag distribution, and emotion distribution.

features.label: Monthly report
features.description: Mood chart, mood peaks, mood counts, entries per day, tags used, words written, most used emotions and tags.

features.label: Yearly report
features.description: Year in pixels, mood chart, best and worst month.

features.label: Streaks and goals
features.description: Streaks are calculated in code but not shown anywhere in the app. No goals or achievements.

features.label: Correlations between tags and mood
features.description: Statistics show tag counts and peaks, not correlations.

features.label: Daily reminder
features.description: One daily notification at a time you choose.

features.label: Color scales
features.description: Choose one of 5 mood color scales.

features.label: Dark mode
features.description: Follows the system light or dark setting.

features.label: 31 languages
features.description: The app is translated into 31 languages.
features.note: The App Store listing lists English only.

features.label: Data stays on your device
features.description: Entries are stored on the device. No account or sign-up. The phone's own backup (iCloud, computer, or Google Account) may include them.

features.label: Export
features.description: Export all entries as a JSON file through the share sheet.

features.label: Import
features.description: Import a Pixy JSON export, for example on a new phone. No import from other apps.

features.label: Delete your data
features.description: Reset entries or reset the whole app from settings.

features.label: Cloud backup and sync
features.description: No sync between devices. No Pixy cloud. See automatic-backup for the OS backup.

features.label: Automatic backup
features.description: Entries are part of the phone backup: iOS device backup (iCloud or computer) and Android Auto Backup to the Google Account, encrypted with the screen lock. Pixy never sees the data.
features.note: Android Auto Backup is in source since the first release after 1.88.0. Not in the store version.

features.label: App lock
features.description: Passcode lock removed in 1.10.1. No PIN or Face ID lock.

features.label: Anonymous usage analytics and crash reports
features.description: Anonymous usage data (PostHog) and crash reports (Sentry) help find errors. Disclosure, not a selling point.

features.label: No ads
features.description: No ads in the app.

features.label: Open source
features.description: Source code is public on GitHub under the MIT license.

features.label: Vote on features
features.description: Vote on upcoming features from the settings.

features.label: In-app feedback and surveys
features.description: Send feedback or report an issue. An optional check-in step asks short survey questions.

features.label: Guided onboarding
features.description: First-run walkthrough of calendar, statistics, filters, reminder, and privacy.

features.label: Home screen widgets
features.description: Not in the app.

features.label: Apple Watch and Wear OS
features.description: Not in the app.

features.label: AI features
features.description: Not in the app.

features.label: Photos
features.description: Not in the app.

features.label: Voice notes
features.description: Not in the app.

features.label: CBT exercises
features.description: Not in the app.
